name: unsafe fn from_raw_handle (handle : RawHandle) -> Self
rule: `handle` may have the value `INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE` (-1), provided it is an owned, open handle for a resource that may be freed via `CloseHandle`.
api: impl  std::os::windows::io::handle::HandleOrNull { unsafe fn from_raw_handle (handle : std::os::windows::io::raw::RawHandle) -> Self }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: handle ownership, open status, and `CloseHandle` compatibility have no corresponding observations.
